area: Team server sign-in: SAML 2.0 (signxml) set up on the Team server page or by the environment, passkeys (py_webauthn) alone or after the password, and an administrator's passkey requirement
title: Wave 9: SAML 2.0 sign-in and passkeys for team servers, with the identity provider's metadata treated as untrusted input

coverage.how: acceptance tests 1-5 of the spec each mapped to a test: tests/test_team_saml.py (assertion validation and signature wrapping), tests/test_team_passkeys.py (software authenticator), tests/test_team_signin_settings.py (page settings, metadata, second factor, required passkeys, lockout)

checks.what: An unsigned, wrongly signed, SHA-1, expired, wrong-audience, wrong-recipient, unsolicited or replayed assertion is refused; a signed one signs the mapped account in, with environment or page-saved settings
Oversized metadata and metadata with a DTD, an internal, external or parameter entity are refused before anything is expanded or fetched
A registered passkey signs in; a replayed challenge, a wrong origin or RP ID, no user verification or a counter that does not go up is refused
With require passkey on, a password-only sign-in of a local account gets no session; an account with a passkey needs its own passkey after the password
The new public routes (SAML ACS, metadata, login, finish; passkey options, login, enroll) are on the public route list and in team_routes; the administrator routes refuse every other role
SAML cannot be turned on half set up; the local test makes no outbound call

findings.title: A locked account could still finish a SAML sign-in: the lockout was checked on password and passkey sign-in only
findings.fix: The SAML finish step refuses a locked account (423)

findings.title: A passkey that failed to verify did not count towards the account's lockout, so a known credential could be retried without limit apart from the per-address limit
findings.fix: team_server.record_failure counts a failed passkey like a wrong password; a right password no longer resets the count while a second factor is still due

findings.title: Refused SAML responses were not rate limited, so the assertion consumer service could be hammered with forged responses
findings.fix: A refused response counts towards the address's sign-in limit; over it the ACS answers 429 before parsing

findings.title: The assertion consumer service read its form body inside the route, outside the deny-by-default body readers the contract test enforces
findings.fix: team_api._saml_form reads the size-capped URL-encoded body (ASCII, at most ten fields)
